Owner-operated preview

Social research and drafting, under human control.

Dionysus AoA Social Connector lets an authorized creator collect and organize material from their own social accounts, select useful items, and prepare publication drafts. It uses official platform APIs and keeps every publishing decision with the human operator.

See how it works Read the privacy policy

Purpose

A focused tool for a creator's own accounts.

The connector is designed for research, selection, and content preparation. During the current preview it is limited to the developer's own authorized accounts. It does not scrape social networks, sell personal data, manage advertising, or access private data belonging to unrelated users.

Collect

Read the authenticated creator's permitted profile, boards, Pins, posts, videos, and related metadata.

Organize

Filter and arrange authorized material into a useful working set for research and editorial planning.

Prepare

Create drafts and publication plans. Any future publish operation requires a separate, explicit human confirmation.

Instagram X Pinterest TikTok YouTube

Control and transparency

No password collection. No silent publishing.

Account access is granted by the platform's authorization flow and can be revoked by the operator. Credentials are not requested through this website. The source code and support channel are public, while account tokens and retrieved private data remain outside the public repository.
